headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.13
summary: The What's new dialog no longer overflows off-screen with no way to close it, and a crash loop from the animated background density slider is fixed.

items.text: The What's new dialog no longer grows past the screen — content scrolls inside the capped area and Continue stays visible.
Animated background density above 100% drew past the glyph pool and crashed the app; the slider now caps at 100%.
Vietnamese translation refreshed to 100% via Weblate.
